'''Aris''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served the [[Believers]] [[Sith cult/Legends|Sith cult]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Aris accompanied a group of Believers to a [[Metatheran Cartel Tilnes base|secret base]] of the [[Metatheran Cartel]] trade alliance on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Tilnes]] to investigate the results of an [[Anti-Caarite virus|experimental virus]] dispersed by the cult in the facility. However, the group became trapped inside the Cartel base and were attacked by the [[mutant]] [[Caarite]] [[Ko Bas]], leaving Aris and the Believer [[Osia]] as the only survivors from the Believer strike team. Three [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] later, Aris and Osia ambushed a team of [[Heroes of Cularin|freelance agents]] who had ventured to the Cartel installation and were defeated by them.

==Biography==
Aris was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived during the last [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and became one of the [[Believers]], a [[Sith cult/Legends|Sith-worshipping cult]] active in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]].<ref name="CA" /> Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="date">The ''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]'' states that the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] campaign is set one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], an event that is dated to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. As the ''Living Force'' adventure ''[[Below the Belt: Philology|Philology]]'' [[Cularin's disappearance|moved]] the campaign forward ten years to the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the events depicted in ''[[Metatheran Caution: Caaried Away|Caaried Away]]'' can therefore be dated to circa [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].</ref> Aris became involved in a Believer plot to develop a [[Anti-Caarite virus|new virus]] [[Death/Legends|fatal]] to the [[Caarite]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Two [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] after a staged release of the virus within a [[Metatheran Cartel Tilnes base|base]] of the Caarite-dominated [[Metatheran Cartel]] trade alliance on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Tilnes]], the cult determined to investigate the success of their experiment. Aris was among a group of six Believers selected for the assignment and instructed to a rendezvous at a [[Cantina/Legends|bar]] in the<ref name="CA" /> floating [[City/Legends|city]]<ref name="LFCG">''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]''</ref> [[Tolea Biqua]]<ref name="CA" /> on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]].<ref name="LFCG" /> He was briefed on only the essential particulars of the mission and was kept in the dark about many key details including where to communicate their findings and the Believers' designs to use the virus to [[Speciecide|wipe out]] all Caarites.<ref name="CA" />

The Believer strike team traveled to Tilnes on a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] and made their way to the Cartel base, which was located deep beneath the surface of the moon within a network of tunnels. Just as Aris and his comrades arrived in the facilty, an [[Electromagnetic pulse/Legends|electromagnetic pulse]] emitted from the core of Tilnes triggered the base's security systems to seal the entrance, trapping the Believers inside. The cultists soon fell under attack from [[Ko Bas]], a Caarite who had been transformed by the virus into an enlarged, raging [[mutant]] being, resulting in the deaths of four of their party, leaving Aris and the Believer [[Osia]] as the only survivors.<ref name="CA" />

In search of shelter, Aris and Osia came across a concealed security office and hid inside. There, they came upon two more mutated Caarites, [[G]] and [[U]], whom they subdued by using [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Mind trick/Legends|control their minds]] and by speaking to them in the [[Caarimala|Caarite native language]]. The two Believers then set about attempting to bypass the base's security system so that they could leave the Cartel facility, but their efforts were to no avail.<ref name="CA" />

{{RPG|''[[Metatheran Caution: Caaried Away|Caaried Away]]''}}
Three [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] after the Believers arrived at the base, a group of [[Heroes of Cularin|freelance agents]] arrived at the facility, investigating a [[Distress signal/Legends|distress signal]] that that was activated by the electromagnetic pulse that caused the base to seal. Their arrival took the [[Sith cultist/Legends|cultists]] by surprise and Aris and Osia observed from a distance as the operatives fought and defeated Ko Bas, and also as the agents discovered an active sample of the anti-Caarite virus. Determined to ensure that the existence of the virus remained a secret, Aris and Osia quickly assumed positions near to the entrance to the Cartel base, planning to ensnare the operatives as the agents attempted to leave.<ref name="CA" />

The Believer pair made their presence known to the freelance agents and Osia offered to let the operatives leave unhindered if they would surrender the virus specimen they had recovered. The agents declined and Aris and Osia attacked them, while also commanding U and G to kill the freelancers. The agents subsequently defeated the two cultists and departed the base with the viral sample.<ref name="CA" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
A devoted member of the Believers, Aris thought that doom would befall the enemies of the cult. As was standard for Believers, he bore on his right shoulder a [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoo]] of the spire of the [[Almas Sith fortress|Sith fortress]] on the planet [[Almas]].<ref name="CA" />

==Powers and abilities==
Aris was adept in the [[Force power/Legends|use of the Force]] to [[Force sense|sense]] things, [[Telekinesis/Legends|move objects]], perform mind tricks, [[Enhance Attribute|enhance his physical attributes]], and also to [[Force healing/Legends|heal]] himself and others. He was [[Language/Legends|bilingual]], being fluent in the languages [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] and Caarite.<ref name="CA" />

==Equipment==
During his assignment on Tilnes, Aris wore a [[Breath mask/Legends|respirator]] to protect himself from the effects of the experimental virus. He was also equipped with a [[blast helmet]] and [[Blast vest/Legends|blast vest]] and he wielded a [[Stun baton/Legends|stun baton]] and [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]].<ref name="CA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Aris appeared in ''[[Metatheran Caution: Caaried Away|Caaried Away]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure by [[Morrie Mullins (real person)|Morrie Mullins]] set within [[Star Wars Legends]] continuity. The adventure was released in [[March]] [[2003]] and served as the opening instalment of the [[Metatheran Caution trilogy]] of [[RPGA]]'s [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|Living Force]] campaign.<ref name="CA" />

In the adventure, the players roleplay as the freelance agents that encounter Aris in the Cartel base on Tilnes and various different outcomes are possible. If the player characters obey Osia's ultimatum to hand over the sample of the anti-Caarite virus that the agents recovered, the pair of Believers keep their word and allow the player characters to leave the Cartel base unhindered. Aris and Osia then depart the facility via a different set of tunnels to the freelance agents and head to the Believer strike teams' starship to leave Tilnes. If the player characters refuse to hand over the virus specimen, a fight breaks out with the two Believers and it is possible for Aris to be defeated and killed.<ref name="CA" />

In the event that the player characters are beaten in the fight with the two Believers and incapacitated, Aris and Osia collect the virus sample and depart the base with the mutant Caarites U and G accompanying them, leaving the freelance operatives alive as they had no orders to kill any non-Caarites. If Aris is captured by the player characters he attempts to strangle himself to death with the Force, though his attempt at suicide can be thwarted if the agents knock him out or perform a mind trick on him. It is then possible for the player characters to coerce Aris into disclosing all that he knows about the virus and the Believers' mission to Tilnes.<ref name="CA" />
